resources.string: Home base for everything: browse the web, open your Library, cast phone files, and more. Each card takes you to a section. Swipe across the cards for more. Tap Reorder to move any feature or Bridged App — the first two tiles on each page are larger.
Tap the status pill or the Connection card to pair with your TV. Once connected, any video you find can be sent to the big screen.
See this blocks icon in the top bar? Every screen has it. Tap it any time to return to the Dashboard.

Optional protection for browsing in PlayBridge. Download the Mozilla-signed extension from Mozilla Add-ons, then review and approve its permissions in a native prompt. Private browsing and data collection are not granted automatically. You can skip this and install it later through Extensions.
Preparing or downloading uBlock. Installation still requires your permission approval.
uBlock is already installed. Its settings and enable/disable controls are in Extensions.
